summary: Frontend-only verification of Obserra Agentic AI Security app-wide sweep: (A) Defensibility Auditor Room readiness deep-dive and (B) Authority & Tools sub-card clickability. All acceptance criteria PASS. Login as admin, Skip tour, navigated to Agentic AI Security. Defensibility deep-dive renders rating pill ('Low 0'), 'Score 0/100', all facets (SHARING RISK, TOXIC AGENTS ACTIVE, GOVERNED AGENTS, OPEN QUESTIONS, LINK EXPIRES, plus OVERDUE QUESTIONS, ENFORCEMENT EVENTS, AGENTS KILLED, WEEKLY SUBSCRIBERS, OPENS · DOWNLOADS, COMPLIANCE ALIGNMENT chips NIST AI RMF/ISO 42001/SOC 2/EU AI Act), an AI INSIGHT & RECOMMENDATION section with modelled dollar impact and RECOMMENDATION text, and a deep-dive-close testid. Regression: digest-preview-btn opens the board digest preview overlay; agentic-governance-settings card renders with gov-sla-urgent/high/hours/low, gov-escalation-mult, gov-oncall inputs. Authority & Tools tab: agentic-tools and agentic-permissions panels render; tool-intel-<ref> (AGT-001, AGT-002) and perm-intel-<ref> (AGT-001, AGT-002, AGT-003) rows are buttons and, when clicked, open the AgentDetailModal with agent-enforce-suspend / -kill / -resume buttons rendered (not clicked). No frontend errors surfaced other than a benign 401 on some non-blocking resource.
critical_code_review_comments: AgentDetailModal.jsx uses a raw fixed-inset overlay without role="dialog"/aria-modal; consider adding for a11y and easier test hooks.

AuditorRoomCard listing includes multiple testid patterns (auditor-room-<tok>, auditor-room-log-<tok>, auditor-room-renew-<tok>, auditor-room-list) which look similar under a simple prefix filter; disambiguating (e.g., auditor-room-row-<tok> vs auditor-room-log-<tok>) would improve automation robustness.
seed_data_creation: No new rooms created; two pre-existing auditor rooms were used for readiness verification. Nothing left to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-dive modal content uses ALL-CAPS facet labels (e.g., 'SHARING RISK', 'TOXIC AGENTS ACTIVE'), so keyword matching should be case-insensitive. AgentDetailModal is a fixed-inset overlay (not role=dialog); scrape via '.fixed.inset-0' innerText. Authority tab exposes only 2 tool-intel rows (agents with action tools) and 3 perm-intel rows; expected. Ensure any prior modal is closed before clicking a new agentic-tab-* to avoid intercepts.
